bannerText: Lost contact with the mother device.
bannerNoGame: This device has no saved game to resume. Use a device that was in the game.
rejoinNotFound: No mother found on the network for this game.
becomeMotherBody: This device hosts the running game in place of the mother, which no longer answers. It resumes from the last saved state, and the other devices reconnect to it automatically.
becomeMotherNote: Scans made in the few seconds before the stop may be missing. Resume the game on one device only.
promoting: Resuming the game on this device…
promotedBody: This device now hosts the game. The other devices will reconnect within a few seconds.
stickyMotherNote: This device hands back to the mother as soon as it returns: nothing else to do.
regainBody: {{name}} is hosting a running game in place of this device. Take the game back on this device now, or let it finish on {{name}}?
regainNote: If you take it back now, this device first pulls the game's latest state, so nothing is lost. Otherwise it takes the hosting back by itself when the game is over.
regainTaking: Pulling the latest state and resuming the game…
regainDone: This device hosts the games again. The other devices are reconnecting.
errSnapshotFetch: Could not fetch the current game state from the active mother - it may have just gone offline. Try again.
errNoSnapshot: No cached snapshot for this game on this device - it can't be promoted. Pick a device that was in the game.
errNotInGame: This device was not part of any running game (no saved state, and no other host reachable). Join the game on this device first, or resume it from a device that was in it.
errTakeControl: Could not host on this device: another device may already be hosting. Try again in a few seconds.
errMotherUnreachable: The current mother is not answering. Check that it is on, that Playground is open on it and that this device is on the same Wi-Fi, then retry.
errStaleSnapshot: This device already holds the latest version of the game. Restart Playground on this device, then try again.
errScenarioMissing: This device hasn't downloaded this game's scenario. Sync it (Settings → Sync), then retry.
errAdoptFailed: Taking over the game on this device failed and was rolled back: nothing was changed. Retry; if it happens again, take over from another device.
errPortBusy: Another program is using Playground's network port on this device. Close other Playground windows, then retry.
errNotAuthorized: The current mother refused this device. Join it first (Settings → Network → Advanced options → Search for a mother), then try again.
errGeneric: The operation failed. Retry in a few seconds; if it happens again, send the technical details to support.
errHostingActiveGame: This device hosts a running game ("{{name}}") and no other device serves it. Stop the game first.
bannerReconnecting: Reconnecting to the mother, please don't touch anything.
takingOverBy: {{name}} is taking over, reconnecting, do not touch anything.
alreadyTakenOver: {{name}} has already taken over: this device joined it, nothing else to do.
errProtoMismatch: This device and the mother don't run the same Playground version. Update them to the same version.
bannerNoMother: No mother found on the network.
hostAsSubstitute: Host the games as a substitute
hostedEmpty: This device is hosting now, but no running game was found on it. To resume a game, use a device that was in the game.
twoMothersBody: This device and {{name}} are both set as mother. There can only be one per account. Which one do you keep?
twoMothersNote: Playground restarts on this device to apply your choice. The device that is not kept becomes a satellite and sends its games to the mother.
